# Create a GitHub Issue

AI_CONTEXT_VERSION: 2026-05-22
Generated from .ai-source. Prefer editing .ai-source files, then run scripts/ai-sync-context.mjs.

Use when turning an observation or request into a GitHub issue.

1. Capture the problem, user value, and project-specific context.
2. Include implementation notes without over-prescribing internals.
3. Add acceptance criteria and verification expectations.
4. Note safety, privacy, deployment, or content cautions.
5. Link related files or docs when known.

Output: title, summary, implementation notes, acceptance criteria, and priority suggestion.
